title: eremopyrum pectinatum
intro: Eremopyrum pectinatum, commonly known as wheat grass or Turkey wheatgrass, is a type of perennial grass native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eremopyrum pectinatum include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
